source: actual mobile TSX handlers and scope/cooldown hook
cases: actual reset validator rejects malformed email/code and password bounds before any request
actual account scope synchronously locks code and verify requests and aborts on cleanup
actual route/token/service/unmount invalidation aborts requests and rejects late account writes
actual cooldown retains an absolute sixty-second deadline independent of email input
actual reset handler refuses mismatched confirmation without a POST
duplicate send clicks POST once and use fixed non-enumerating feedback
actual reset errors never echo provider password or OTP details
late reset and binding success after route change cannot mutate the next page
binding sends current-password proof and cannot write status after account replacement
verified binding updates only the current form and clears password/code proof inputs
